findings.title: KeyError when ticket status not present in ALLOWED
findings.explanation: The function accesses ALLOWED[ticket.status] without checking that ticket.status exists as a key. If a Ticket has a status not defined in the ALLOWED mapping (e.g., a new enum value added later), a KeyError will be raised instead of the intended InvalidTransition, breaking error handling expectations.
findings.verification_note: The function indexes ALLOWED with ticket.status without checking for key existence, so a Ticket whose status is not a key in ALLOWED would raise a KeyError instead of InvalidTransition.

limitations: Ticket model definition is not provided, so potential issues with shallow copying of mutable fields via dataclasses.replace cannot be fully assessed.
The definition of the Ticket dataclass is not provided, so we cannot assess whether copying it with dataclasses.replace could unintentionally expose or mishandle sensitive fields.
